name: @map-harness/spatial-terrain
description: Terrain and line-of-sight analysis contracts: the versioned TerrainSpec binding (vertical datum/units/epoch, horizontal CRS, exact resource revisions, accuracy budget, sampling policy), the gridded elevation surface with bilinear interpolation and building/voxel obstacles, and the sampled line-of-sight computation with earth-curvature/refraction correction, obstruction diagnostics (terrain/building/voxel), slant/horizontal distances under an explicit local-tangent-plane distance definition, and clearance uncertainty that makes grazing sightlines honestly indeterminate. A pure library the terrain tools consume — no host row.
